Europe on Alert Amid Russian Sabotage and Hybrid Warfare Concerns

European nations are increasing civil defense measures and intelligence warnings due to suspected Russian sabotage and hybrid warfare activities. Denmark's intelligence agency reported Russia is actively preparing acts of sabotage, while Western officials accuse Moscow of a campaign of disruption aimed at undermining support for Ukraine and destabilizing Europe. Finland is conducting its largest civil defense exercise since World War II, with an eye on Russia. The EU's top court ruled that autocratic rule alone is insufficient to freeze assets of Russia-linked companies, requiring solid proof of actual control. Russia's strikes near Moldova have also raised alarms about its plans for Europe's eastern flank.
